input: read ./prompt.md and follow the instructions there
task: perf: slowest unprofiled test file in shift-roster-builder (own-site-wage.test.mjs)

doc_friction.issue: The first `git merge origin/main` after a depth-1 fetch failed with 'refusing to merge unrelated histories'; the deepen step is in CLAUDE.md but land-your-work.md's 'git fetch --depth=1 origin main' advice leads straight into it.
Gives per-suite times only; finding the slow file took a hand-rolled per-file xargs timing. A per-file list for the top suites would have saved a step.

goal: Cut agent and CI wait on the shift-roster-builder suite without changing any answer.
notes: Metric: wall time of own-site-wage.test.mjs's brute-force test and of the suite. Before 62.2 s, after 33.7 s (node --test --test-reporter=spec own-site-wage.test.mjs, alone, same container). One over-booked pinned buildRoster call 252 ms -> 38.5 ms (mean of 50). Suite (run_venture_tests.py shift-roster-builder, 4 jobs, same container): 235.4 s (684 tests) -> 220.6 s (686 tests). Cause: openHoursFloor's max flow splits shifts across a person's weekly hours, so coverPass's floor stop never fired on over-booked weeks. Fix: wholeShiftCap subset-sum caps; coverPass stops on max(openFloor, wholeShiftFloor); ctx.openFloor unchanged. Same answers: 0 of 1,536 pinned builds and 0 of 135 seeded weeks differ old vs new (JSON minus timings). Local checks: run_workflow_locally.py --for-changes (see PR).

pricing.source: Anthropic pricing as cached in the Claude API skill (models table and per-model migration notes), 2026-10-06. Cache writes are 1.25x input (5-minute) and 2x input (1-hour); cache reads differ by model.

human_equivalent.basis: profiling a solver test, designing and proving a tighter LP-flow floor, equivalence check and write-up: about a day's half for a senior engineer

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
server-tool fees (web search is billed per search, not per token); the count is recorded, not priced
